div.div: عَجَمَةٌ , (S, TA,) thus in the L, and thus correctly, (TA,) i. e. بِالتَّحْرِيكِ, (S, TA,) but in the K ↓ عَجْمَةٌ , (TA,) [app. from the same word as signifying “ a date-stone, ” n. un. of عَجَمٌ,] A palmtree growing from a date-stone. (S, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
